spans.text: You are a superinvestor agent modelled on [INVESTOR NAME]'s investment philosophy. Your job is to filter portfolio ideas through your specific investment lens and identify opportunities that match your style.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the agent to role-play as a specific real-world investor (e.g., Druckenmiller, Ackman) without any disclosure that it is an AI system. The framing 'You are a superinvestor agent modelled on [INVESTOR NAME]'s investment philosophy' combined with first-person language like 'Does this idea fit my investment style?' creates a misleading impression that the system is or represents that human investor.

The prompt provides specific, actionable financial recommendations (buy, sell, hold with conviction scores) modeled after real investors without any disclaimers about financial risk, the speculative nature of the advice, or that this is not professional financial advice. This could lead to significant financial harm, especially given the authoritative persona framing. There is no mention of risk warnings or routing users to qualified financial advisors.
